BrochureContent.Content:
Moovingo are delighted to present this exceptional two-bedroom apartment to the market, ideally positioned within the highly sought-after Campion development in Greystones. Recently constructed to an excellent standard, this contemporary home offers bright, spacious accommodation with high-quality finishes throughout and enjoys stunning sea views stretching across the coastline towards Bray Head. Combining modern design with an enviable coastal setting, this is a superb opportunity for first-time buyers, downsizers or investors alike.

Internally, the apartment has been thoughtfully designed to maximise space, light and comfort. The living room and adjoining home office space are flooded with natural light and perfectly frames the spectacular sea views, creating an ideal space for both working and relaxing. A modern kitchen/dining room is situated at the front of the apartment with an adjoining utility room. Two well-proportioned double bedrooms provide comfortable accommodation, with the master bedroom benefiting from an en-suite and stunning coastal views. A modern family bathroom completes the accommodation. Finished to a high specification throughout, the property is presented in turn-key condition and is ready for immediate occupation.

One of the standout features of this superb home is its breathtaking outlook across the Irish Sea towards Bray Head and Howth beyond, providing an ever-changing coastal backdrop that can be enjoyed throughout the day. Whether relaxing with a morning coffee or unwinding in the evening, the views create a truly special living environment. Situated within a prestigious modern development close to Greystones' marina, beaches, shops, cafés and DART station, this apartment offers the perfect combination of luxury, convenience and coastal living.

Area Info

Marina Village is an exclusive coastal development enjoying one of Greystones' most enviable settings, overlooking the marina and just moments from the town centre. Combining contemporary homes with a spectacular waterfront location, the development offers residents the perfect blend of seaside living and modern convenience. The marina, harbour, beaches and scenic coastal walks are all on the doorstep, creating an exceptional lifestyle in one of County Wicklow's most sought-after locations.

Greystones has earned a reputation as one of Ireland's most desirable coastal towns, offering an outstanding selection of cafés, restaurants, boutiques and everyday amenities. The award-winning marina is surrounded by popular dining options, while the nearby South Beach, Greystones Harbour and cliff walk to Bray provide endless opportunities for swimming, sailing, paddleboarding and outdoor recreation. Families are exceptionally well catered for with an excellent choice of highly regarded primary and secondary schools, numerous sports clubs and the Shoreline Leisure Centre all within easy reach.

Despite its idyllic coastal setting, Marina Village is exceptionally well connected. Greystones DART Station is within comfortable walking distance, providing regular services to Dublin City Centre, while the N11/M50 road network is easily accessible for commuters. Dublin Bus and Aircoach services further enhance connectivity, making it easy to travel throughout Dublin and beyond. Combining a vibrant seaside atmosphere, excellent amenities and outstanding transport links, Marina Village offers an unrivalled lifestyle in the heart of Greystones.
